author: Liqe
body:
MY username is Whacka_. Yesterday I was banned by the senior moderator LegendaryEngram. This really disappointed and devastated me as Avicus Network is my absolute favourite server and I would always play preliminary to any other server. All of my friends play on this server and I feel completely and utterly left out and discriminated by my punishment. I promise you with full recognition I have never layed eyes on or interacted with any hacking client and/or mod. My reason you may have thought I was hacking is that I am currently experiencing a completed driver lag on my PC and sometimes I glitch about mostly during fights and wars and the code for hitting and running completely and negatively bug out my laptop. To conclude this appeal I would solemnly appreciate it if I could be allowed back on Avicus.

Thank you for reading this appeal and I truly hope to hear back from however may read this of any importance.

Yours sincerely,

Whacka_ A.K.A sergeant_wosika(old name)
